threads.body: This labels the OpenInference run as exercising `mistral`, while the native run for the same shared `mistralai` scenarios declares `mistralai`. The runner passes this value into report/data tooling, so the two implementations will be grouped as different instrumented libraries instead of remaining directly comparable. Use the imported SDK/distribution name consistently in both configurations.

threads.body: The tool-call response keeps `CHAT_RESPONSE`'s hard-coded model instead of echoing the requested model, unlike the ordinary chat path below. A tool call made with any other model will therefore report the wrong response model and can produce incorrect `gen_ai.response.model` coverage.

@@ -0,0 +1,209 @@
+"""Mistral-compatible endpoints (chat completions, FIM and embeddings).
+
+Mounted under ``/mistral``, the prefix the agents blueprint already uses:
+Mistral serves chat completions at the same ``/v1/chat/completions`` path as
+OpenAI, and one path cannot answer as two providers. A scenario points the
+SDK's ``server_url`` at the prefixed base URL.
+"""
+
+import copy
+import json
+
+from flask import Blueprint, Response, request
+
+from ._common import mock_json_schema_value, mock_tool_arguments, sse
+
+bp = Blueprint("mistral", __name__, url_prefix="/mistral")
+
+CHAT_RESPONSE = {
+    "id": "mistral-mock-001",
+    "object": "chat.completion",
+    "created": 1700000000,
+    "model": "mistral-small-latest",
+    "choices": [
+        {
+            "index": 0,
+            "message": {
+                "role": "assistant",
+                "content": "This is a response from the mock server.",
+                "tool_calls": None,
+            },
+            "finish_reason": "stop",
+        }
+    ],
+    "usage": {
+        "prompt_tokens": 25,
+        "completion_tokens": 12,
+        "total_tokens": 37,
+    },
+}
+
+# Mistral validates a tool call id as exactly nine alphanumeric characters,
+# and rejects the result message that carries it back otherwise.
+TOOL_CALL_ID = "call_mock"
+
+
+def _tool_call_response(body):
+    resp = copy.deepcopy(CHAT_RESPONSE)
+    resp["id"] = "mistral-mock-002"
+    tool = body.get("tools", [{}])[0]

threads.body: `mistralai==2.9.4` accepts `encoding_format`, so this scenario leaves `gen_ai.request.encoding_formats` unmeasured in both implementations. Pass an explicit format such as `"float"` and regenerate both data files.

+"""Conformance scenario: Mistral embeddings.
+
+A different operation, so a different span type, which is why this is its own
+program rather than another call inside inference.py. Batched input and an
+explicit dimension count, since each is an attribute the conventions declare
+for this operation. Mistral's embeddings API takes no encoding format.

threads.body: Mistral 2.9.4 accepts `input_audio` in chat messages, so image is not the only supported non-text input. Add an audio exchange and mock coverage so both implementations measure its content shape and token counts.
